attributes.board_name: New York State Board of Nursing (NYSED Office of the Professions)

rules.alternatives: No general CE hours for NP or RN registration renewal and no national certification requirement for renewal. Mandatory trainings still apply: infection control every 4 years and one-time child abuse reporting (via the RN license); prescriber education on pain management, palliative care and addiction for DEA registrants.

topics.who: Prescribers with a DEA registration; pain management, palliative care and addiction; completion attested online to the NYS Department of Health (NEAT)
Required of RNs (NPs hold an RN license)
Required of RNs (NPs hold an RN license) unless exempt
All DEA-registered practitioners (federal one-time requirement, in addition to the NYS 3-hour training)

rules.notes: NP and RN registrations are renewed every 3 years with NYSED; fee $35 per NP certificate plus $73 for the RN registration. The NYS prescriber training is due once every 3 years and attested to the Department of Health.
